learnings: Classes are objects whose class is `type`; `type(name, bases, namespace)` creates classes at runtime.
A metaclass's `__new__` runs at *class definition* time, so it can validate and register plugins before any instance exists.
`__init_subclass__` covers most real use cases (registration, validation) without a metaclass.
pitfalls: Combining two unrelated metaclasses raises a metaclass conflict – a strong reason to prefer simpler hooks.
